title: I/O Port Programming
lead: Covers lecture 03, the six I/O-port lecture recordings and exercises 1 and 2, written for complete beginners: electricity basics, binary/hex, DDR, PORT and PIN, bit operations, the blinker in assembly, C and Arduino (systems 1 to 4), delay-loop maths, reading a pushbutton, building circuits by hand, everything the lecturer added in class (section L) and worked solutions.
